catalog_title: ClinResearch AI - Unified Error & Severity Catalog

errors.label: Missing Primary Outcome
errors.description: The primary outcome measure is not explicitly defined in the research protocol. The study has no clear target for success or sample size justification.
errors.correction_method: Define exactly one primary outcome, specify its measurement method, unit of measurement, and assessment time-points.

errors.label: Undocumented Randomization
errors.description: The protocol states it is a Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) but fails to specify the method of sequence generation or block sizes.
errors.correction_method: Specify sequence generation (e.g. computer random number generator, block size of 4 or 6, stratified by center).

errors.label: Missing Blinding Specifications
errors.description: For an RCT, the protocol does not clarify who will be blinded (e.g. participant, operator, outcome assessor).
errors.correction_method: Clarify the blinding status of all key actors. If blinding is not possible (e.g. open surgery vs placebo), state why and how detection bias will be controlled.

errors.label: Incomplete Sample Size Parameter Set
errors.description: The sample size calculation lacks one or more critical inputs: alpha, power, expected difference/effect size, or dropout rate.
errors.correction_method: Provide all inputs: alpha (usually 0.05), power (typically 0.80 or 0.90), effect size (with scientific citation or justification), and expected attrition.
errors.reference_guideline: Rosner Fundamentals of Biostatistics & Chow Sample Size Calculations

errors.label: Unjustified Normality Assumption
errors.description: Using parametric statistical tests (like t-test or ANOVA) on sample distributions without testing normality or addressing non-normality.
errors.correction_method: Verify distribution using Shapiro-Wilk or Kolmogorov-Smirnov test. If distributions violate normality, utilize non-parametric tests (e.g. Mann-Whitney U, Kruskal-Wallis).
errors.reference_guideline: Altman Practical Statistics for Medical Research (Normality Assumptions)

errors.label: Unaddressed Confounding in Observational Study
errors.description: Running unadjusted statistical tests on cohort or retrospective studies without controlling for baseline covariates.
errors.correction_method: Use propensity score matching (PSM), multivariable regression models, or stratified analysis to adjust for potential confounders.
errors.reference_guideline: STROBE Statement (Item 12 - Statistical Methods for Confounding)

errors.label: Out of Range Clinical Value
errors.description: Clinical value entered for patient metrics exceeds physiological boundaries (e.g., patientAge = 150, pocketDepth = -1.0).
errors.correction_method: Re-measure and cross-check clinical input against the verified physiological guidelines catalog.
errors.reference_guideline: WHO Health Data Standards & Clinical Rules Catalog

errors.label: Duplicate Patient ID in CRF
errors.description: An identifier code for a subject (e.g. PT-001) has been entered multiple times for the same visit point.
errors.correction_method: Assign unique codes for subjects or correct patient identifier entry mismatch.

errors.label: Extreme Periodontal Destruction Warning
errors.description: Pocket depth exceeds 6.0 mm or Clinical Attachment Loss (CAL) exceeds 5.0 mm, indicating severe periodontitis.
errors.correction_method: Initiate advanced clinical intervention protocol (SRP or surgical root planing) and notify clinical principal investigator.

errors.label: Procedural Hypertension Alert
errors.description: Patient's systolic BP exceeds 140 mmHg or diastolic exceeds 90 mmHg prior to surgery / procedure.
errors.correction_method: Wait for 10 minutes and re-measure BP. Avoid high-epinephrine local anesthetics if pressure remains hypertensive.
